PocketBudJet opens with a splash screen after install. Wait for it to finish, then continue.
Swipe the feature showcase. Control your money with envelopes, bills, and goals on your phone. Tap Next.
Your AI financial coach learns your patterns and flags unusual spending. Tap Next.
Crush your debt — watch loan progress and your debt-free date on the Quick Tour. Tap Next.
Your data stays on your device — privacy first. Tap Get Started.
On first launch, the Terms of Service tab is open — scroll to the bottom.
Tap Disclaimer and scroll that tab to the bottom too.
When both tabs are reviewed, tap I Accept — Continue.
On Secure Your Data, toggle app lock if you want PIN or biometrics, then tap Continue to Home.
You land on Home. Income, spending, and net cards sit at the top with widgets below.
The wayfinding tour opens on first launch. Landmark one: the tab bar — Home, Activity, Budget, Goals, and Coach. Tap Next.
Landmark two: the header — Universal Search and the Coach button on every screen. Tap Next.
Landmark three: the drawer — swipe from the left for Settings, Help, and the full nav map. Tap Next.
Landmark four: the Toolbox — import, export, scanners, and utilities in one place. Tap Next.
Landmark five: the quick-add button logs a transaction, category, or goal depending on your tab. Tap Done to finish the tour.
On your second app open — or after five transactions — you may see Choose Your Plan. Start the 15-Day Premium trial with no card, or continue free.
After onboarding, PocketBudJet may ask to send bill reminders and spending alerts. Allow notifications to stay ahead of due dates.
Setup is optional and not shown by default. Tap the gear icon, open Settings, then tap Set Up PocketBudJet to launch the wizard any time.
Wizard step one: enter your display name and tap Next.
Wizard step two: choose your home currency and tap Next.
Wizard step three: add checking, savings, credit, or cash accounts — or tap Skip.
Wizard step four: tap Income and enter gross pay and take-home pay. The difference becomes paycheck deductions you can itemize later.
Wizard step five: add recurring bills with name, amount, and due day — or tap Skip.
Wizard step six: pick your main financial goal to personalize the dashboard.
Wizard step seven: choose a budgeting style — 50/30/20, Envelope, Zero-Based, or another template.
Wizard step eight: answer the colorblind-accessibility question, then tap Continue so charts use friendly palettes.
Wizard step nine: review your personalized summary, then tap Finish. Your dashboard is configured.
On Home, scan hero cards for income, spending, and net worth. Widgets below show spending pace, bills due, and goal progress.
Tap the Activity tab — wallet icon at bottom left — to see every transaction.
Activity lists income and expenses grouped by date. Use search and filters to narrow by merchant, category, or amount.
Tap the filter icon to stack date, category, and account filters. Running balances update per account as you scroll.
Tap any row to open Transaction Detail — edit category, split, add notes, or attach a receipt.
When imports add uncertain rows, open Approve Transactions to accept or fix them before they hit your budget.
Tap the Budget tab — calendar icon — for envelope limits and monthly progress.
Budget shows category envelopes with color-coded progress bars and rollover amounts.
Tap any category row to rename it or change the monthly limit.
Tap Change Template to switch frameworks like 50/30/20, Envelope, or Zero-Based.
Category Manager lets you add, merge, or hide categories and sub-categories.
Spending Plan shows how much is left per envelope after bills and goals — your safe-to-spend number.
Tap the Goals tab — trending-up icon — for savings targets and sinking funds.
Goals tracks targets with progress rings, wishlist cool-offs, and sinking funds for irregular expenses.
Tap the plus button. Enter a name, target amount, and date. PocketBudJet calculates your monthly contribution.
Add sinking funds for annual expenses like insurance. Use the wishlist to cool off on impulse buys before committing.
Purchase Wishlist lets you queue wants with a cooling-off timer before money leaves your account.
Tap the Coach tab — sparkles icon — for insights, reports, and AI chat.
Coach's Today segment highlights anomalies, bill reminders, and nudges based on your data.
Tap Ask to chat in plain English — try "How much did I spend on dining last month?"
Weekly Recap summarizes income, spending, and wins from Coach or your notification.
To log spending manually, open Activity or tap the gold plus button from any screen.
Tap the gold plus button at bottom center. You can finish in under ten seconds.
Tap Amount and enter it first while it is fresh. Amount is the one field you must not forget.
Type the merchant name consistently. Pick a category — PocketBudJet learns and suggests over time. Select the account.
For multi-category receipts, tap Split. Assign portions to Groceries, Household, or other categories — total stays locked.
Tap Save. Your budget category, account balance, and dashboard update immediately — no sync wait.
Open Toolbox, then Import Center. Share a bank statement into PocketBudJet — no bank login required.
Share from your bank app is the path. The steps look similar everywhere, but labels and menus vary by bank. Tap Show me how for the typical flow.

In your bank app, find Statements or Document Center — or whatever your bank calls it — open a statement, tap Share. If PocketBudJet is not in the first row of apps, tap More or the ellipsis, find PocketBudJet, then Import takes it from there.
PocketBudJet opens Import with your statement and builds a draft. Wait for the list to appear.
Review the draft. Confident rows are ready; flagged rows need a quick look. Tap Import N new transactions when the list looks right.
Share at least three months of statements — six months or a year is better. More history means clearer reports and better coaching on Home.
When import finishes, your transactions are on Home and Activity. Import another statement the same way anytime.
Import History keeps past shares if you need to re-open a batch later.
Tap Scan Receipt and snap a photo. OCR fills merchant, amount, and date.
Review OCR fields, pick a category if needed, then tap Save. Line items parse when visible on the receipt.
For stacks of paper, open the document scanner in Toolbox and follow the on-screen steps to bring pages in.
Load a stack of receipts and walk away — every page gets read, categorized, and added to Activity.
Universal Scan works for statements, invoices, and mixed documents — crop the corners, review, then import.
On Bills, the calendar shows due dates with payday markers and a 30-day cash flow forecast.
Tap Add Bill for subscriptions and recurring payments. Tap a due date to mark paid or snooze a reminder.
Subscription Tracker surfaces recurring charges you might have forgotten — cancel leaks before they compound.
Recurring Transactions links bills and income on one timeline for cash-flow planning.
Recurring Income stores paychecks and side gigs so forecasts know when money arrives.
Import or photograph a pay stub — Pay Stub Review splits gross, taxes, and deductions automatically.
Direct Deposit Advisor suggests how to split paychecks across accounts and envelopes.
On Debt, enter balances, APR, and minimum payments.
Choose avalanche — highest interest first — or snowball — smallest balance first. See your debt-free date and interest saved.
Loan Calculator models extra payments, refi scenarios, and payoff timelines.
Debt Progress Report charts how fast balances are falling month over month.
In Coach, tap Reports for spending by category, income vs expenses, and custom layouts.
Spending Trends compares month over month. Spot seasonal spikes before they become habits.
Category Breakdown shows where money went. Export any report segment as CSV or PDF from the share icon.
Merchant Analysis ranks stores by spend — great for cutting subscriptions and dining.
Financial Health Score grades savings rate, debt load, and budget adherence in one number.
Report Builder lets you save custom filters — reuse them for monthly reviews.
Net Worth tracks accounts, investments, property, and liabilities in one view.
How PocketBudJet Learns shows how categories improve as you correct them — your numbers stay on your phone.
Bank sync is for US banks with paid Premium — not included in the free trial. Two banks are included; each extra bank is an add-on. Tap Connect to begin.
In Settings, tap Connect Bank. Search for your US bank and sign in securely — PocketBudJet never stores your bank password.
Tax Filing Export bundles categories and mileage for your accountant or tax software.
Tax Center groups mileage logs, deduction breakdowns, and annual summaries in one place.
Mileage Log tracks business miles with IRS-ready totals — start trips from the Toolbox or a widget.
Deduction Breakdown summarizes tax-prep categories pulled from your categorized transactions.
Tap the gear icon for accounts, privacy, backups, data retention, and the setup wizard.
My Profile and Accounts manage display name, institutions, and account types.
Household sync lets you share a budget with a partner on the same plan. Follow the invite steps on each phone.
In Privacy and Backup, tap Backup to turn on encrypted cloud backup, set retention, and control app lock.
Under Data Management, tap Storage to set how much history lives on-device, manage receipt image storage, and archive old years.
How PBJ Learns explains crowd-consensus categorization — your data stays private on-device.
Bank sync connects US institutions only via Teller. Requires paid Premium — not included in the 15-Day trial. Two banks included; each extra is .99 per month. Tap Connect to begin.
In Settings, tap Connect Bank. Search for your US bank. PocketBudJet never stores your bank password — Teller handles sign-in.
Choose checking, savings, or credit accounts to link. New transactions sync automatically and honor your categorization rules.
Open Activity, tap a transaction, then Transaction Rules. Automate categorization for repeat merchants.
Set a rule: when merchant contains "Coffee Shop", assign Dining. Rules auto-apply to future imports and manual entries.
Flag unusual rows with Bookmarks. Filter Activity to bookmarks only when reconciling at month end.
Say "Hey Siri, log $12 coffee in PocketBudJet" or use Google Assistant shortcuts. Hands-free entry while driving or cooking.
Ask "How much is left in Groceries?" or "What's my net worth?" Voice works for budgets, balances, and Coach questions.
Retirement Planning asks for your target age, annual expenses, and current portfolio. Tap Target Retirement Age, then fill in the rest to see your FIRE number.
Couples Dashboard shows shared envelopes and who spent what — each phone still keeps its own local copy.
In Settings, open Purchase Wishlist. Tap Add Item to cool off before big buys — wait thirty days, and if you still want it, it is worth it.
Shopping Intelligence compares prices, tracks UPC history, and flags impulse patterns at checkout.
Launch PC Web Companion from Toolbox. When it is running, scan the QR code or open the magic link on a PC on the same Wi‑Fi.
Notification Capture can turn bank alerts into draft transactions — turn it on in Settings if you want it.
Couples Dashboard merges shared envelopes and shows who spent what — still stored locally on each phone.
Tap Universal Search in the header. Find transactions by merchant or amount — or search features like "mileage" or "voice."
Connect Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, or iCloud for encrypted backup. Your cloud account, your control.
Notification Capture reads bank alerts from your notification shade and drafts transactions — opt in from Settings.
Widgets and Watch complications show safe-to-spend, bills due, and quick-add — configure slots from Settings.
In Settings under Data and Privacy, tap Require app unlock to turn on biometric or passcode lock before transactions appear.
Connect Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, or iCloud for encrypted backup. Your cloud, your account, your control.
Need help? Email support@josspatech.com or use in-app feedback. This manual at josspatech.com/videos/user-guide/ covers every feature.
